description: This file defines the TranslationHelper class, responsible for managing and adding translations from YAML files into a database within the OrangeHRM system. It handles reading translation files, checking existing records, and inserting new translation data into the database.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing system translations, including loading YAML files, and inserting translation records into the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Reads translation data from a YAML file for a specific language and adds it to the database.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves an individual translation record into the database, creating new entries if they do not exist.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal language ID from the database given a language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance for executing database queries.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Fetches an existing translation record ID for given language string ID and language ID.
